# Littré

*1801 – 1881 · French · [Positivism](../movements/positivism.md)*

French lexicographer and philosopher, author of the great Dictionnaire de la langue française: he popularized Comte's [positivism](../movements/positivism.md) but rejected its religion of Humanity.
